verdict.rationale: Anytype documents automation entry points: a local API, a headless CLI "for automation and scripting," an MCP server, and an agents skill that runs scripts. Nothing in the evidence shows a way to version, review, or roll back automations themselves. Dated API versions describe the API contract, not user automations, and backups cover channel data, so neither counts toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
